description: Mirror AbaNinja into CallPilotAI so the data can be analysed and reconciled: addresses (companies AND private persons, the same list as app.abaninja.ch/addresses/list), master data (products, product groups, time-tracking employees), documents (quotes and invoices) and their positions. AbaNinja stays the leading source — nothing is ever written back. Positions are fetched one document at a time because AbaNinja's list endpoints do not return them, so a single call fetches at most `max_positions` documents and reports how many are still outstanding. The job is done when `offen` is 0, not when the call returns. Run it again to continue.

max_positions.description: How many documents to fetch positions for in this call (default 60, max 300). Each one is a separate API request.

positions_type.description: Restrict the position batch to one document type — quotes first is usually what you want.

scope.description: Default 'all': addresses, master data (products, product groups, employees), documents, then one batch of positions.

name: sync_abaninja
